title: DIG-3409 push blocked ~85 min by duplicate-work guard
summary: Pre-push guard scans 556 branches on first push; push running, lands in ~1h unaided.

questions.prompt: Push of DIG-3409-spike-cleanup (1 commit, 115 deletions, tests 37 passed) is running but the pre-push duplicate-work guard needs ~85 min (556 unmerged origin branches x git log -p + patch-id). Authorise a one-time bypass for this push, or let it run to completion unaided?

options.label: Authorise one-time bypass for this push

questions.prompt: The guard has no short-circuit for pure-deletion single-commit pushes and no timeout escape. Who should own a permanent fix (skip scan or cap branches)?

result.reason: Moot by event: the guarded push completed and PR #5881 merged into develop at 2026-10-19T04:53:27Z. The card predates that outcome.
